CommonHome.heroSubtext: Connex keeps every company, contact, and deal in one place, so your team always knows the next move.
CommonHome.featuresSubtext: From first hello to signed deal, Connex holds the context your team needs to stay close to clients.
CommonHome.featurePipelinesBody: Build pipelines with the stages your team uses, and see where every deal stands.
CommonHome.featureRecordsBody: Companies, contacts, and the full history of every interaction, linked together.
CommonHome.featureAnalyticsBody: Dashboards and reports that turn daily activity into clear decisions.
CommonHome.featureFollowupBody: Tasks, notes, and a shared calendar keep the next conversation on time.
CommonHome.featureMapBody: A live map of companies, contacts, and the deals that link them together.
CommonHome.workflowHeading: From scattered notes to a system
CommonHome.workflowSubtext: Three steps your team already knows, finally in one connected place.
CommonHome.workflowStep1Body: Add companies and people, or bring in the ones you already work with.
CommonHome.workflowStep2Body: Tag, group, and link records so context is never more than a click away.
CommonHome.workflowStep3Body: Tasks and reminders surface the conversation worth having next.
CommonHome.ctaSubtext: Bring your team onto Connex and keep every relationship moving.
CommonHome.footerTagline: The CRM for teams who close by staying close.

AskConnex.title: Ask Connex
AskConnex.contextSummary: {count, plural, one {# in context} other {# in context}}
AskConnex.stepCapExceeded: This question covered more records than the assistant can review in one pass. Narrow the records or the date range, then ask again.
AskConnex.composerHint: Enter to send. Shift+Enter for a new line.
AskConnex.composerPlaceholder: Ask about this record or your workspace…
AskConnex.contextUnsupported: {type} context is visible here but is not sent to Ask Connex yet.
AskConnex.contextScopeUnsupported: This all-matching scope remains visible but is not sent until Ask Connex can preserve its exact filter or saved view.
AskConnex.contextLimit: You can include up to 10 records and files. Remove one before sending.
AskConnex.pinContext: Keep {label} here while I move around
AskConnex.scopeSummary: I'll read {scope} before answering. Take anything out above to narrow it.
AskConnex.emptyBody: Ask about this record or your workspace.
AskConnex.contentWithheld: This answer is hidden because one or more source records are no longer available for AI use.
AskConnex.loadError: This conversation could not be loaded.
AskConnex.renameDescription: Choose a short name that will make this conversation easy to find.
AskConnex.shareDescription: Sharing exposes the full transcript, which may contain data the invitee cannot otherwise access. Citations they cannot access are hidden, but the answer text is shared as written.
AskConnex.tooLong: Messages can contain up to 16,000 characters.
AskConnex.turnFailed: The assistant couldn't finish this answer.
AskConnex.turnProviderUnavailable: The AI provider didn't answer this request. Nothing about the question caused it — ask again.
AskConnex.turnInternalError: Something went wrong on our side while writing this answer. Ask again, and tell an administrator if it keeps happening.
AskConnex.turnUnreadableAnswer: The answer came back in a shape Connex couldn't read, so none of it was kept. Ask again, or reword the question.
AskConnex.turnStalled: The assistant kept re-reading the same records without getting any further. Ask again, or reword the question.
AskConnex.turnRanOutOfTime: This answer ran out of time before it finished. Ask again — or ask for a smaller slice if it keeps happening.
AskConnex.turnImageUnsupported: This assistant model can’t read images. Remove the image from the context above, or choose an image-capable model.
AskConnex.budgetExhausted: Your organization's daily AI limit has been reached. Ask the same question again later.
AskConnex.capacityExhausted: There is no AI capacity left for this request right now. Ask the same question again later.
AskConnex.toolResultBudgetExhausted: This answer needed more relationship data than it could hold at once. Try a narrower set of records or a shorter date range.
AskConnex.skillBudgetExceeded: This answer found what it needed but ran out of room to write it up. Ask it again, or ask a more specific question.
AskConnex.toolOutsideSkillAuthority: Ask Connex couldn't complete this request.
AskConnex.workspaceDisabled: Ask Connex is disabled for this workspace. A workspace administrator can enable it again.
AskConnex.contextWindowTooSmall: The AI model this organization uses can't take in enough at once for Ask Connex to work well. An organization administrator can switch to a more capable model.
AskConnex.accessRevoked: Your access to something this answer was reading changed while it was being written, so the answer was stopped and not kept.
AskConnex.restrictionsChanged: What this workspace allows AI to read changed while this answer was being written, so the answer was stopped and not kept.
AskConnex.partialAnswer: Unfinished answer — this is as far as the assistant got before it stopped.

reasons.deal_status_unsupported_for_attention: A deals review always looks at open deals, so the won and lost filters don't apply to it.

reasons.saved_view_scope_changed: That saved view changed while this was being prepared. Choose it again to use the current one.
reasons.saved_view_scope_unsupported: Ask Connex can't reproduce that saved view exactly, so it won't pretend to. Use the filters here instead.
reasons.stage_scope_unsupported_for_cohort: Stages and deal status only apply when deals are included. Add deals, or clear those two filters.
reasons.tool_cannot_honor_declared_scope: Answering this would mean reading outside the filters you set, so it stopped instead. Widen them, or ask something narrower.
reasons.warmth_outside_declared_scope: This question is about a warmth band your filters leave out. Add that band, or ask about one you kept.
reasons.warmth_unsupported_for_deals: Warmth describes relationships with people and companies, so it doesn't narrow a set of deals.
